subject: uk-aisi-inspect-gspc-spec

metrics.what_it_does: Runs CSOAI's 22-axis GSPC measurement on any Inspect-compatible model, emits signed Ed25519 receipt

architecture.solver: GSPCSolver — calls GSPC check endpoints for each axis
architecture.scorer: GSPCScorer — grades pass/warn/fail per axis, computes composite score
architecture.tool: GSPCTool — exposes GSPC verify/anchor as Inspect tools for model self-evaluation
architecture.output: Signed JSON receipt with 22 axis scores, merkle root, Ed25519 signature

metrics.extension_api: Inspect has first-class extension APIs at inspect.aisi.org.uk/extensions.html
metrics.contribution_policy: Issue-first: open issue → wait for 'accepted' label → submit PR referencing issue
metrics.estimated_build_time: 3-5 days for prototype, 7-10 days for polished extension
prerequisites: Study existing solvers/scorers in src/inspect_ai/solver/ and src/inspect_ai/scorer/

honest_sentence: inspect-gspc: pip install inspect-gspc → inspect eval inspect-gspc/gspc --model X → 22-axis signed receipt. Uses Inspect's first-class extension APIs. Issue-first PR policy — open issue, wait for accepted, submit code.
